title: Length bound for the recursive encoding
statement: For every list $cs$ of clauses over $V$ and every starting index $i$, the number of 3-clauses produced by recursively encoding $cs$ from index $i$ is at most the total number of literals in $cs$ plus twice the number of clauses in $cs$.
